title: OptionOpen
description: obs.option_open r1: one planned option contract pulled at the open of a session day and slot; one row per planned item. Open interest is not stored (stale intraday; the page joins the last obs.option_eod value). A crossed quote (bid above ask) is kept as written: the dataset has no quality column.

capture_id.description: Identifier of the capture, a uuid. Deterministic per (session_day, slot, instrument_id), not random (option_eod's is random): a retry of a key after a partial write meets the primary key and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and cannot duplicate a row.

slot.description: Slot of the pull as four digits, for example 0945; the value refresh marks a row of the refresh button.

plan_id.description: Identifier of the plan (plan.option_open_item) the row was pulled from.

generation.description: Generation of the instrument terms the capture used.

market_data_type.description: Broker market data type of the tick: 1 live, 2 frozen, 3 delayed, 4 delayed frozen.

requested_at.description: Instant the quote was requested from the pull core, UTC.

sent_at.description: Instant the request was sent to the broker, UTC; null when never sent.

received_at.description: Instant the answer was received, UTC.

event_ts.description: Instant of the quote at the venue, UTC; null when unknown.

connection_generation.description: Generation of the broker connection the row was pulled on.

status.description: Final status: 1 ok, 2 partial, 3 no_data, 4 not_listed, 5 no_subscription, 6 deadline, 7 deferred, 8 error, 9 disconnected.

error_code.description: Error code of the broker or the pull; null when none.

skew.description: True when the spot of the stock moved 1 percent or more within the group of the row.

outside_band.description: True when the band at the open spot leaves the contract out; the row is not asked and has status 7.

currency.description: Currency of the prices, three upper-case letters.

last.description: Last trade price. Null when absent.

volume.description: Volume of the day. Null when absent.

underlying_price.description: Price of the underlying at the end of the group. Null when absent.

underlying_ccy.description: Currency of the underlying, three upper-case letters.

underlying_event_ts.description: Instant of the underlying quote, UTC; null when unknown.

iv_bid_decimal.description: Implied volatility as a decimal (0.25 is 25 percent). Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

iv_mid_decimal.description: Implied volatility as a decimal (0.25 is 25 percent). Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

iv_ask_decimal.description: Implied volatility as a decimal (0.25 is 25 percent). Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

iv_decimal.description: Implied volatility as a decimal (0.25 is 25 percent). Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

delta.description: Delta. Null when absent; the writer turns -1 into null.

gamma.description: Gamma. Null when absent; -1 is not a value.

theta_per_calendar_day.description: Theta per calendar day. Null when absent; the writer turns -1 into null.

vega_per_vol_point.description: Vega per volatility point. Null when absent; -1 is not a value.
